typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Adhoc_run_id as integer (),
	BUS_FILE as string (),
	BUS_FILECC as string (),
	BUS_PATH as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL_CC as string (),
	DateTime as string (),
	Email_CC as string (),
	Email_From as string (),
	Email_To as string (),
	Excel_Name_final as string (),
	Excel_Name_final_CC as string (),
	Excel_Path as string (),
	Filename as string (),
	FilenameCC as string (),
	Instance_Name as string (),
	ORA_Password as string (),
	ORA_Server as string (),
	ORA_Username as string (),
	RUN_ID as integer (),
	SMTP_Connection as string (),
	Table_data_Summary as string (),
	Table_data_Summary_CC as string (),
	V_ERR_EXISTS as integer (),
	V_ERR_EXISTS_CC as integer ()
}

source(output(
		CONTRACT as string,
		HCID as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		DOB as string,
		GENDER as string,
		CIRS_ENTITY as string,
		ERROR_DESC as string,
		FILETYPE as string,
		INBOUNDFILENAME as string,
		FILELOADDTM as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CONTRACT,        HCID,        FIRST_NAME,        LAST_NAME,        DOB,        GENDER,        CIRS_ENTITY,        ERROR_DESC,        FILETYPE,        INBOUNDFILENAME,        FILELOADDTM   FROM AGP.CIRS_ERROR_REPORTING  WHERE RECORD_TYPE = \'D\' AND FILETYPE=\'CONF\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of GENDER} = GENDER,
		{Copy of FILETYPE} = FILETYPE,
		{Copy of DOB} = DOB,
		{Copy of FIRST_NAME} = FIRST_NAME,
		{Copy of ERROR_DESC} = ERROR_DESC,
		{Copy of HCID} = HCID,
		{Copy of CIRS_ENTITY} = CIRS_ENTITY,
		{Copy of LAST_NAME} = LAST_NAME,
		{Copy of CONTRACT} = CONTRACT,
		{Copy of FILELOADDTM} = FILELOADDTM,
		{Copy of INBOUNDFILENAME} = INBOUNDFILENAME) ~> DataConversion
